name: Can I perform a roof inspection myself?

mainEntity.name: Can I perform a roof inspection myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: While homeowners can visually check their roof from the ground for obvious issues, a professional roof inspection offers a more thorough and safe assessment. Professionals have the necessary safety equipment, training, and experience to identify subtle damage, assess hard-to-reach areas, and recognize specific signs of wear or manufacturing defects that an untrained eye might miss. They can also provide informed recommendations based on their expertise.
acceptedAnswer.description: Homeowners can do basic visual checks, but a professional roof inspection provides a safer, more thorough assessment. Experts identify subtle damage and hard-to-reach issues an untrained eye might miss.
